query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Retrieve Trello card comments, update Trello cards, and perform broader project-management and automation-maintenance operations across task boards, email, chat, and an automation platform.
query_ground_truth.query: modify the information on the task card and set its status to closed
query_ground_truth.rationale: Updating card properties and closing/archiving cards requires these specific mutation endpoints in Trello.

request.query: modify the information on the task card and set its status to closed

results.use_case: modify the information on the task card and set its status to closed
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if status values are unknown or a prior status change was rejected)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch list configuration using CLICKUP_GET_LIST (identify allowed status values).
[Optional (if custom field IDs/options/types are unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch custom field schema using CLICKUP_GET_ACCESSIBLE_CUSTOM_FIELDS (capture field_id and required value encoding).
[Optional (if a custom field expects people references)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch list members using CLICKUP_GET_LIST_MEMBERS (map people to member IDs used in field values).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Fetch current task state using CLICKUP_GET_TASK (verify it exists; note current status and custom_fields to change/keep).
[Required (after explicit confirmation)] [Step]: Update task status (and other simple attributes) using CLICKUP_UPDATE_TASK (send at least one modifiable field).
[Required (after explicit confirmation)] [Step]: Set each custom field value using CLICKUP_SET_CUSTOM_FIELD_VALUE (one call per field_id with correct value shape).
[Optional (if a field must be cleared)] [Next Step]: Remove a stored custom field value using CLICKUP_REMOVE_CUSTOM_FIELD_VALUE (use when “empty” writes don’t unset).
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Re-fetch the task using CLICKUP_GET_TASK (confirm status/custom field updates applied).
[Optional (if CLICKUP_UPDATE_TASK fails due to invalid status)] [Fallback]: Re-check allowed statuses using CLICKUP_GET_LIST (then retry with a valid status).
known_pitfalls: [CLICKUP_GET_TASK] Responses can be large; pull only needed fields (status, custom_fields) to avoid oversized context.
[CLICKUP_SET_CUSTOM_FIELD_VALUE] Value encoding is field-type specific (e.g., option IDs vs free text); mismatches commonly trigger validation errors.
[CLICKUP_UPDATE_TASK] Status changes can be rejected if the status is not enabled for the task’s list; confirm allowed values via list configuration.
[CLICKUP_REMOVE_CUSTOM_FIELD_VALUE] Some field types do not clear via empty/blank writes; explicit removal is required to truly unset.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: ClickUp unifies tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform, allowing teams to plan, organize, and collaborate across projects with customizable workflows
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=clickup. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="clickup") to create a connection BEFORE executing any clickup tools.

CLICKUP_UPDATE_TASK.description: Updates attributes of an existing task; `team_id` is required if `custom_task_ids` is true, use a single space (" ") for `description` to clear it, and provide at least one modifiable field.

parent.description: ID of new parent task to make this a subtask; cannot convert subtask to regular task this way.

status.description: New task status (case-sensitive, must be valid in Workspace).

task_id.description: Unique task identifier; use custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is true.

team_id.description: Team ID, required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

archived.description: True to archive, false to unarchive.

due_date.description: New due date (Unix timestamp in milliseconds).

start_date.description: New start date (Unix timestamp in milliseconds).

description.description: New task description; use a single space (" ") to clear.

due_date_time.description: True if `due_date` includes time, false if all-day.

assignees__add.description: List of user IDs to add as assignees.

assignees__rem.description: List of user IDs to remove as assignees.

custom_item_id.description: Custom task type ID. Use `1` for Milestone, its ID for custom type. Omit/`None` to make regular task (API's 'null' equivalent).

custom_task_ids.description: If true, `task_id` is a custom ID and `team_id` is required.

start_date_time.description: True if `start_date` includes time, false if all-day.

CLICKUP_SET_CUSTOM_FIELD_VALUE.description: Sets or updates a Custom Field's value for a task; the new value (with type-dependent structure, e.g., `{"value": "text"}` or `{"value": 123, "value_options": {"currency_type":"USD"}}`) is provided in the JSON request body.

value.description: The value to set for the Custom Field. Structure depends on field type: Text/Short Text: string (e.g., 'Hello'). Number/Currency/Emoji(Rating): number (e.g., 42). Checkbox: boolean (true/false). Dropdown: option UUID string from type_config.options (e.g., '7a4e5845-8496-4b9f-9097-843b9c737692'). Date: Unix timestamp in milliseconds (e.g., 1645502400000). Email: valid email string. Phone: string with country code (e.g., '+1 123 456 7890'). URL: valid URL string. Labels: array of label UUIDs from type_config (e.g., ['label_id_1', 'label_id_2']). Users/Tasks: object with 'add' and/or 'rem' arrays of IDs (e.g., {'add': ['id1'], 'rem': ['id2']}). Location: object with 'location' (lat/lng) and 'formatted_address' (e.g., {'location': {'lat': -28.0, 'lng': 153.4}, 'formatted_address': 'Gold Coast, Australia'}). Manual Progress: object with 'current' value (e.g., {'current': 50}).

task_id.description: Task ID to update. Standard ID, or Custom Task ID if `custom_task_ids` is true.

team_id.description: Team ID, required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

field_id.description: UUID of the Custom Field to update (must be in standard UUID format with hyphens, e.g., '0f079e26-feef-410d-8e8d-2a21a057ee5e'). Obtainable via 'Get Accessible Custom Fields' or 'Get Task' endpoints.

value_options.description: Optional settings for certain field types. For Date fields: {'time': true} to display time in ClickUp UI. For Currency fields: {'currency_type': 'USD'} to specify currency.

custom_task_ids.description: If true, `task_id` is treated as a Custom Task ID, and `team_id` is required.

CLICKUP_GET_TASK.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a ClickUp task by its ID, supporting standard or custom task IDs (requires `team_id` for custom IDs).

task_id.description: The unique identifier of the task to retrieve. This can be the standard ClickUp task ID or a custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is set to `true` (in which case `team_id` is also required).

team_id.description: The ID of the team. This parameter is required and used only when `custom_task_ids` is set to `true` to identify the custom task ID within that specific team. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

custom_task_ids.description: Set to `true` to indicate that the `task_id` provided is a custom task ID. If `true`, `team_id` must also be provided. If omitted or `false` (default), `task_id` is treated as a standard task ID.

include_subtasks.description: Set to `true` to include subtasks in the task details response. If omitted or `false` (default), subtasks are not included.

include_markdown_description.description: Set to `true` to return the task description in Markdown format. If omitted or `false` (default), the description is returned in plain text. For example: `?include_markdown_description=true`.

CLICKUP_GET_ACCESSIBLE_CUSTOM_FIELDS.description: Retrieves all accessible Custom Field definitions for a specified ClickUp List using its `list_id`.

CLICKUP_GET_LIST.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing List in ClickUp, identified by its unique `list_id`.

CLICKUP_GET_LIST_MEMBERS.description: Retrieves all members of a specific, existing ClickUp List by its ID.
